experiment.steer: S015 §130 every significant specimen gets the full pass; Odyssey's two educational goals discharged PER SPECIMEN

device.reason: offline weight-space study, no GPU execution

representation.name: grouped absmax
representation.anchor: bits=4 group=64 is EXACTLY ws_rtn_q4_g64, pinned by a test against the shipped packer

why_this_block: G048 tracks TWO educational goals and had discharged ONE. 'How does this computation want to EXECUTE' was answered for all 4 specimens; 'how does this architecture want to EXIST' was carried for model #2 alone and NOT ATTEMPTED for the other three. This attacks the second across every specimen on disk.

the_question_was_narrowed_on_purpose.what_this_cannot_be: an adequacy claim. This campaign sealed on 2026-07-27 that every prior sub-bit negative was a GAUSSIAN-PROXY ARTIFACT and that compression must be judged on real activations, and on 2026-08-17 that LOCAL ADEQUACY DOES NOT COMPOSE. No model was executed here and none could be -- the runtime lacks Qwen3-MoE, Falcon and Mamba readers.
the_question_was_narrowed_on_purpose.what_it_is: does the ORGAN RANKING under grouped absmax TRANSFER ACROSS ARCHITECTURES? Prior campaign law, measured on Qwen: ATTENTION SETS THE BPW FLOOR. Falcon-H1 is a hybrid with state-space organs that have no Qwen analogue; Kimi-VL and Qwen3-VL carry vision towers. That is falsifiable and it was falsified.

headline: THE PRIOR LAW IS ARCHITECTURE-SPECIFIC, NOT GENERAL. Attention sets the floor on BOTH Qwen models -- q_proj needs group 32 where every MLP and expert tensor clears at group 128 -- and DOES NOT TRANSFER: on Kimi-VL and Falcon-H1 no organ is more demanding than any other. The mechanism is within-group outliers, confirmed at Pearson -0.9841 across 33 organs and 4 architectures.

the_ranking.Qwen3-30B-A3B: attention_q 0.98471 < attention_k 0.98732 < attention_v 0.98788 < embed 0.98629 ... < mlp/expert 0.9913-0.9931. SPREAD 0.0084.
the_ranking.Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B: same shape, slightly cheaper: attention_q 0.98705, expert 0.99267.
the_ranking.Kimi-VL-A3B: EVERY organ 0.99303-0.99324. SPREAD 0.0002 -- 40x tighter than Qwen.
the_ranking.note_on_a_label: Qwen3-30B-A3B has NO dense MLP, so its 'mlp_gate' row is an EXPERT tensor (experts.10.gate_proj). Recorded rather than relabelled, because a row called mlp_gate that is an expert would mislead anyone reading the table.

the_gaussian_reference_is_the_control_an.reading: structureless noise of the same scale reaches cosine 0.99321 at 4b/g128, within 2e-05 across three shapes. THAT IS A REFERENCE POINT, NOT A FLOOR: real weights sit AT it or BELOW it, never meaningfully above.
the_gaussian_reference_is_the_control_an.what_it_resolves: Kimi-VL sits AT the reference on every organ, so under THIS measurement its weights are indistinguishable from noise of the same scale -- a statement about the measurement's resolving power on that model, NOT a claim that the weights are random. Qwen3-30B's attention_q sits 0.0085 BELOW it, 26x further than Kimi's largest deviation, which is where the measurement has real content.

the_mechanism_was_a_claim_so_it_was_test.prediction_written_first: cosine FALLS as mean(amax/rms) RISES, so a STRONG NEGATIVE correlation confirms the mechanism; anything near zero refutes it
the_mechanism_was_a_claim_so_it_was_test.means: grouped absmax spends its levels on the largest weight in a group, so a group whose amax sits far above its rms wastes range on one outlier. The correlation holds ACROSS architectures, not within one -- which is what makes it an explanation of the ranking rather than a restatement of it.
the_mechanism_was_a_claim_so_it_was_test.gaussian_ratio: 2.83, and every organ measured 2.9-3.5, so the ordering is entirely a story about how far above 2.83 an organ's outlier ratio sits

depth_robustness_because_the_surprising_.verdict: BOTH surprising claims survive depth. Qwen3-30B attention_q is below the gaussian reference at ALL FIVE layers sampled (0..44) with a 0.0077 spread; Kimi-VL's expert_gate is AT the reference at all five (spread 0.00011) and its attention_q within 3e-04. The Qwen deviation is ~26x the Kimi one.
depth_robustness_because_the_surprising_.why_it_was_run: the claim rested on ONE tensor per organ, mostly layer 0. A layer-0 accident would have been worthless and there was no way to know without looking.

a_defect_in_my_own_probe.what: the depth probe imported the sweep script to reuse its reader, and that script does work at MODULE LEVEL, so the import silently RE-RAN the entire 205-second sweep and rewrote its output file
a_defect_in_my_own_probe.harm: none here -- the sweep is deterministic and the file was rewritten with identical content -- but an import that re-runs an experiment is a defect that would corrupt any probe with state or randomness, and it is recorded rather than quietly fixed because the pattern is what matters

claim_boundary.weight_space_only: no activations, no model executed, no adequacy. A cosine floor is a NECESSARY-NOT-SUFFICIENT input to Gravity's question and this campaign has a sealed finding that weight-space proxies mislead about the ANSWER.
claim_boundary.sampling: 256 rows of ONE tensor per organ per specimen for the main table (the depth series adds 5 layers x 2 organs x 2 specimens). Grouped absmax makes each row's groups independent, so a row slice is an unbiased sample of GROUPS -- but it is still one tensor, one layer, for most rows.
claim_boundary.ladder_saturates: the coarse floor is 4 bits nearly everywhere because 3 bits fails the 0.99 bar for every organ measured; the informative axis is the GROUP and the continuous cosine, which is why both are reported rather than the floor alone.
claim_boundary.knowledge_level: MODEL_FAMILY not ARCHITECTURE: two Qwen MoE variants agreeing is one family, and Kimi and Falcon are single specimens each.
